whoFor: SCS Partners, and organisations that want a regular, outside view of how the business is run.

benefits.title: A clear view each quarter
benefits.text: One structured look at structure, compliance, operations and growth, every three months.

benefits.title: Priorities, not a long list
benefits.text: Up to three written priorities, so attention goes where it matters most.

benefits.title: Progress you can see
benefits.text: Each review checks what changed since the last one.

whatYouReceive: A quarterly Business Check-Up session with your leadership
The SCS Business Growth Report, with findings and up to three priorities
A short action list with owners for each priority
A follow-up on last quarter's priorities
whatYouProvide: A named contact who can speak for the organisation
Recent management figures and any changes since the last review
Access to the records the review needs
doesNotInclude: Carrying out the priorities themselves, which are scoped as separate projects
Audited figures or an audit opinion
